title: The Fake Family Member Hiding In Plain Sight Part 1

series.summary: Rick discovers that beloved family member Uncle Steve is actually an alien parasite that survives by embedding false memories into their minds, but a new wacky character slips into the house before anyone notices.

cuts.voiceover_text: At breakfast, the family basks in the warmth of their favorite houseguest, Uncle Steve. He has supposedly lived with them for an entire year, quietly becoming the most cherished presence under their roof. When he surprises them by announcing he purchased airline tickets for an all-expenses-paid trip to Paris, the table erupts in genuine joy. Jerry and the kids shower him with affection. To everyone in the room, his love is undeniable, and his place in their family history feels completely unbreakable.

The celebratory mood shatters the moment Rick walks into the kitchen. While Jerry proudly defends his wonderful brother, Rick stops in his tracks with icy suspicion. He has never seen this man before in his life. Jerry insists Rick is simply losing his mind, pointing to a lifetime of shared memories and brotherly affection. Steve tries to laugh off the confrontation with casual humor, but Rick does not hesitate for a fraction of a second. He draws his laser pistol and shoots Uncle Steve dead right through the chest. The dining room descends into sheer pandemonium as purple alien fluid showers across Jerry, while the family screams in absolute horror at what appears to be unprovoked murder.

As the family reels in terror, the corpse on the breakfast table begins to violently contort. Before their eyes, the beloved relative melts into a grotesque, tentacled alien beast. Rick pulls on rubber gloves and delivers a chilling explanation. Uncle Steve never existed. He was a telepathic alien parasite that survives by embedding fabricated, heartwarming memories directly into host brains. Every single precious moment the family remembers sharing with him was an engineered lie designed to let the creature feed and multiply.

Rick warns that the house may already be infested. Everyone must watch closely for any wacky new characters trying to blend in. Immediately, an eccentric stranger named Mr. Poopybutthole cheerfully chimes in to help. Instead of shooting, Rick smiles warmly, treating him like an old friend. Rick is already infected, and no one realizes the parasite is in control.
